correctness.rationale: Start from open-neighborhood total domination and defender exchange, not a scalar bound. If center omitted, each clique requires >=2 selected, and all swaps within a clique or a swap of a selected clique member into the center retain total domination. If center included but one clique empty, the empty clique vertex has only center as possible defender and exchange leaves it isolated; therefore >=1 per clique is necessary and sufficient, with within-clique swaps. Independent subset choices give F_B=z Π((1+z)^ri−1)+Π((1+z)^ri−1−ri z); stripping redundant vertices yields minimal families with sizes t+1 and 2t and M_B=(Π ri)z^(t+1)+(Π C(ri,2))z^(2t). Independent direct defender-exchange checks across 2/3 sized blades and original verify.py enumeration corroborated; all t,ri by logical case proof.
